description: This file defines the VectorStoreComponent class which manages different vector store backends (Postgres, Chroma, Qdrant, Milvus, Clickhouse) for a vector search system, including initialization, retriever creation, and resource cleanup.

classes.name: VectorStoreComponent
classes.description: Manages multiple vector store backends based on configuration, providing initialization, retrieval, and cleanup functionalities.

methods.name: _doc_id_metadata_filter
methods.description: Creates metadata filters based on document IDs from a context filter.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the VectorStoreComponent with the appropriate vector store backend based on settings.

methods.name: get_retriever
methods.description: Creates a VectorIndexRetriever with optional context filtering.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the vector store client if it has a close method.
